summary: Marshall County, MS 100 ft Aermotor beside I-22, NHLR-registered 2022 as US 1603; no build date; a local Facebook post suggests it may have been torn down, which the register does not match.

facts.status_note: Register describes it as a standing guard beside I-22 with no visit date; a Facebook group post asks for photos from before the towers were torn down, so its current state is disputed

evidence.supports: register name Red Banks/Mahon Lookout Tower
100 ft Aermotor standing guard beside the I-22 interstate
evidence.quote: This is a 100ft Aermotor standing guard next to the busy I-22 interstate in North Mississippi.

evidence.supports: site once held a house and workshop for the Marshall County forester; the register's only narrative, with no staffing or fire history
evidence.quote: This site was once home to the Marshall County Forester since it had a house and work shop on the property.

evidence.supports: house appeared to be under renovation by a private individual during the visit
evidence.quote: The house appears to be undergoing renovations by a private individual during my visit.

notes_for_editor: The register page is the only substantive source. The Weebly Forest Lookouts Red Banks page has a Mississippi heading but no text for this tower. The Facebook post was readable only as its title line, so it is cited for the question it asks, not as proof the tower was torn down. Status conflict is unresolved: register says standing (no visit date), post suggests otherwise; check with the Mississippi Forestry Commission or a recent photo before publishing the status. Height 30.5 m is converted from the register's '100ft'. The Mahon name comes only from the register.
